description:
“You’re still the same, getting scared and running away.” 

On the one-hundred-day anniversary, the moment that should have been the happiest turned into a nightmare. Seo Woohee witnesses her boyfriend’s affair with her own eyes. And worse, the other woman is a junior in the entertainment industry whom she treasured more than anyone. Trust crumbles into betrayal in an instant, and her entire world is shaken to its core. At that very same moment, the man who stole her first kiss ten years ago and then disappeared reappears. Her first love, and now her boss: Cha Kyuhyun. 

“Do you know what the surest revenge is?” 

“Meeting a man several times better than that bastard and living happily with him.” 

Love, betrayal, and a fate in which they save each other. An obsessive and dangerous reunion romance.
